title: Strale design token file
description: Validates design/tokens/active.json (a `surfaces` map, one entry per production surface) and every design/tokens/candidates/*.json file (a single surface plus a `status`). See design/README.md for the promotion flow.

colorValue.description: A color token value. Hex for surfaces whose source is hex-native; an HSL triple string ("H S% L%", no hsl() wrapper) for surfaces whose source stores HSL custom properties, so the captured value matches the source file byte-for-byte.

palette.description: Flat map of token name to color value. Keys are the names used in the surface's own source (e.g. `accent`, or `--primary`); no fixed key set, because the two existing surfaces do not share one.

scale.description: Role name to a size descriptor. Free-form per surface (a px number, or an object of responsive values) — the two surfaces' source files do not share one shape.

spacing.description: The surface's spacing scale, smallest first. Used by the lint check to judge whether a margin/padding/gap literal in a consumer file is on-token.

radii.description: The surface's corner-radius scale. Items are px numbers, the strings "50%" / "full" for pill/circle radii, or a CSS length/expression string (e.g. "var(--radius)") when the surface's own source expresses radii that way rather than as resolved pixels.

provenance.description: Where this surface's values were captured from.

source.description: Repo-relative (or cross-repo, e.g. "strale-frontend:src/index.css") path to the file the values were read from.

repo.description: The repository the source file lives in, when it is not this one.

commit.description: The commit the values were captured at.

oneOf.description: active.json — what production currently runs, per surface.

adopted_by.description: The decision id that adopted this surface's values, or the literal string "unrecorded" when no decision record ever did — see design/PROVENANCE.md.

adopted_at.description: ISO date the surface was adopted, or "unrecorded".

oneOf.description: A candidate token file (design/tokens/candidates/*.json) — one surface plus a status.
